title: Rational design and synthesis of potent active antimicrobial peptides based on American oyster defensin analogue A3
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19954-19965
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02745D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jiawei Zhao, Xin Zhang, Yu Liu, Zhixing Geng, Jili Dai, Ye Guo
D-A3 and A3-C6 with high activity, low toxicity and good stability were synthesized by modifying American oyster defensin analogue A3 with D-amino acid or a triazole ring. This study will provide new candidate drugs against microbial infection.
